previous_versions.body: Preloading is a separate issue described here: https://hstspreload.org/ - This is a specialized portion of the HSTS standard to allow your site to be _preloaded in browser software_ so its just not possible to even try to make a HTTP request to a site, even before you visit the site and get a HSTS response header (hence, pre-loading).

Proloading is a separate issue described here: https://hstspreload.org/ - This is a specialized portion of the HSTS standard to allow your site to be preloaded in the browser software so its just not possible to even try to make a HTTP request to a site, even before you visit the site and get a HSTS response header (hence, pre-loading)

## offtopic - issue template

You can use this template wherever you want :) At the moment, till we don't have clear development process written anywhere, this template should be "all discussions in issues should reach to that proposal (template)". Not sure it works as intended as independent template without having process and expectation in place. Current issue template can be improved, I agree.

## on topic

Current issue is spin-off from #963, and as I understand, direction is to make separate "Level 3" requirement additionally for current 14.4.5 with recommending using "preload".

Maybe I didn't investigate enough all the links you provided, but I'm not sure those are all related. That's why I shared my template - with that structure it is clear from ASVS point of view, what kind of change you propose.

This was covered in [ASVS v3.0.1-10.12](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/3.0.1/ASVS-excel-v3.0.1.xlsx)
> Verify that production website URL has been submitted to preloaded list of Strict Transport Security domains maintained by web browser vendors. Please see the references below.

(Not recommending to use it as it is)

I support a level 3 requirement around HSTS preloading, but I prefer not to add PCI-DSS text in it. PCI-DSS does not discuss preloading at all. So @cmlh if you want to take a stab at this requirement, please give it a run here in the issue tracker first. I do not think we need PCI citations attached to the requirement though.

> "_Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted_." which is the same control enforced by Preloading.

Extra parameter `preload` in `Strict-Transport-Security` headers sets limitation to browser, that domains in "preload" list can be accessed only using HTTPS connection. That's it. Nothing about certificates.

> "_Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted_." which is the same control enforced by Preloading.

Extra parameter `preload` in `Strict-Transport-Security` headers sets limitation to browser, that domains in "preload" list can be accessed using HTTPS connection. That's it. Nothing about certificates.

Alternative for adding new requirement, it's possible to use solution like it's done with [3.3.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md)

`+` It does not feel like duplicate requirement, which may be confusing
`-` it is maybe not that clear to read from requirement text alone.
